user.title: Add an airco
user.description: Pick the climate entity of the airco. This is the airco the card controls and the timers turn off.

links.title: Linked entities of {airco}
links.description:
Timers and card act on **{climate}**.

{found} of {total} linked entities were found on the airco's own device and filled in below. Check them, change them, or clear a field to leave that part out.

data.cancel_sleep_on_off: Cancel the sleep timer when the airco is turned off
data.catch_up_minutes: Catch up on a missed timer for up to

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Shown at the top of the card.
data_description.home_leave_select: The airco's own Home Leave select (off / away_heat / away_cool). Drives the Vacant tile on the card; leave empty if the airco has none.
data_description.energy_sensor: Running kWh total, shown as a chip on the card.
data_description.cancel_sleep_on_off: Turning the airco off by any means (remote, app, card) also stops a running sleep timer.
data_description.catch_up_minutes: When a timer came due while Home Assistant was not running, it is still carried out after startup if it is not older than this. 0 turns catching up off.

abort.already_configured: This airco has already been added.
